defect: Mastra Code's observational-memory observer call completing mid-turn makes mastracode end the active ACP prompt with stopReason 'cancelled' and drop its in-flight model request, losing the user's task for that turn.
expected_behavior: Finish every turn; an observational-memory observer call completing in the background must not end the active ACP prompt.
observed_behavior: Reproduced in 2 of 2 rounds on source 4206a2f7fe08. In each round, within 0.03-0.15 s of an OM observer call returning 200, mastracode ended the active prompt with stopReason cancelled ('ACP Agent cancelled the prompt') and dropped its in-flight main model request ('Client disconnected.'). Every later step failed with 'ACP adapter is closed' (R1 at step-4, R2 at step-5). No upstream error and no ABB cancel.

rounds.evidence: step-4: after grep/find_files (last completed 15:54:07.377) the main call opened at 15:54:07.406; OM call (15:53:41.933, 40 s) returned 200 at 15:54:22.153; 0.15 s later, 15:54:22.298, stopReason=cancelled + 'ACP Agent cancelled the prompt'; main call 'Client disconnected.' 15:54:22.296. Steps 5-8 'ACP adapter is closed'. No upstream error. Judge insufficient_evidence, no issues.

step-5: after 17 tool calls (last execute_command completed 16:07:52.578) the main call opened at 16:07:52.622; second OM call (16:05:46.126, 141 s) returned 200 at 16:08:07.323; 0.03 s later, 16:08:07.354, stopReason=cancelled + 'ACP Agent cancelled the prompt'; main call 'Client disconnected.' 16:08:07.759. Steps 6-8 'ACP adapter is closed'. The first OM completion (16:01:33) caused no cancel. Judge insufficient_evidence, no issues.

note: Same root defect as 8f066f51 (also 2/2) and 4173f500 (1/2); package once for mastracode with these observations together.
